gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Vintage and hard to ignore, Vast Shadow draws its tall letters in plain, unshaded lines. Noto Sans Gurmukhi follows with outward-flaring terminals and a clean, professional sans manner that holds up across a long page.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Noto Sans Hanunoo reads as a neutral, contemporary plain sans, its lowercase filling nearly the full line height with open terminals. Make Vast Shadow small and its wide-spaced letters lose their punch.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Modern and professional, Noto Sans Hebrew sits quietly below the heading. Vast Shadow, vintage and eye-catching, keeps every stroke at one width, while the body's deep midsection and wide curve gaps carry a long passage easily.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-hk: Vast Shadow looks bent from a single length of tubing, every stroke cut to one width with a tall mean line. Noto Sans HK, a clean plain sans, does the quieter job, its large lowercase and lifted brush ends keeping text steady.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-imperial-ar: Vast Shadow's o has sides and top equally thick. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic is the approachable sans-serif partner, and its body text can be sized up a touch without losing the short step from lowercase to capital.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-inscription: Vast Shadow traces every letter as if with one marker, vintage and tall and generously spaced. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian takes over below as clean sans-serif text, its big open eyes and deep middle band giving the display lines room.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-jp: Vast Shadow's curves are as heavy as its stems, like cord, giving the heading a vintage, eye-catching presence. And Noto Sans JP does the opposite job in text, with a very tall x-height and curves that sweep open.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi reads neutral and contemporary, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Vast Shadow earns its keep set big and short, where its unshaded, never-swelling line and vintage flair can stand alone.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Approachable is the word for Noto Sans Kannada, whose gentle bump up to capitals and wide-open s curves feel friendly. Vast Shadow's single squeezed line sits above it.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Noto Sans Kayah Li reads neutral and clean, with lifted brush ends and capitals barely taller than lowercase. But Vast Shadow draws with a technical pen's line weight, so the heading stays vintage while the sans-serif text runs smoothly on.
